comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus sort six bottles between crowded rack levels without disturbing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses fine coupled-tool manipulation; the rack task uses repeated grasping, constrained horizontal placement, staging, and collision avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained angle and function; the rack task grades all bottles on color-matched shelves with upright stability and irreversible fall or tilt failures.
comparison.reason: Crowded multi-object sorting and safe placement test a different ability from mechanical adjustment and countertorque locking.
